title: Modern Cowboy Retreat | Hot Tub & Skyline Views
description:
Welcome to your luxury Nashville getaway, just 3 minutes from Broadway! Built in 2024, this brand-new modern cowboy-style home blends rustic charm with upscale comfort, all while offering stunning skyline views from the rooftop. Designed for live music lovers and cowboy/cowgirl enthusiasts, this stylish retreat is the perfect place to experience Music City in style.

The space
🛏️👑 a King Suite with 65" Smart TV
🌃🍸Rooftop Retreat with Nashville Skyline views
🛁♨️ Outdoor hot tub. 
🔥🔥Gas Grill + Fire Pit + Outdoor Heater
🎮🕹️Game Room with Pool + Ping pong +Foosball
💺💆‍♂️Recliner + massage chairs in the game room
🧑‍🍳🥘 Full kitchen
☕️☕️ Nespresso Coffee Maker with Pods
🫖🍵 Kettle and tea bags
🚿🛁 2 Full-size Bathrooms + 1/2 Bath on the 2nd floor
🧴🧴 shampoo, conditioner, and body wash provided
💇‍♀️🔌Hair dryers and straightener
🧺🌀 In-unit washer & dryer
👚🧑‍🔧 Iron & ironing board
📶🌐 High-speed internet
🪞🪞 Full-length mirrors
🔢🔐 Digital Check-in
♨️❄️ Central AC + Heat
🅿️🅿️ Free Parking in the driveway street parking is available

🗺️🧭 Location🧭🗺️

📍📍 Broadway:  3 minutes
📍📍 Nashville Airport (BNA): 7 minutes
📍📍 The Gulch: 7 minutes 
📍📍 Midtown: 7 minutes 
📍📍 21st Ave: 7 minutes
📍📍 12th South: 8 minutes 
📍📍 Enterprise Car Rental 50 ft Away

Guest access
You will enjoy the whole house to yourself

Other things to note
Please note that the hot tub water may not be warm and ready for use on the first day of your stay, as it requires time to properly heat the water to the desired temperature. 
We appreciate your understanding and assure you it will be ready for you shortly after
